submission.justification: Material F1 with 5mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.104% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. This outperforms F2 (4.987%) by 38% and F3 (3.902%) by 20% at the same thickness. The thickness scan for F1 showed that 5mm is optimal, with resolution degrading at both thinner (3.824% at 2mm) and thicker plates (3.345% at 6mm, 4.598% at 10mm). The configuration meets all constraints: F1 is an approved candidate material, 5mm falls within the 2-10mm range, and hands-on maintenance requirements are satisfied.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F1 at 5mm thickness achieves 3.104% energy resolution, which is the best result among all tested configurations (F1: 2mm-10mm scan, F2: 5mm baseline, F3: 4-8mm scan)
